title: Normalized subset indicator
statement: For a subset $A\\subseteq\\mathbb{F}_2^n$, define its normalized indicator at $x$ to be $\\mathbf{1}_A(x)$ divided by the uniform probability of $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a subset of the Boolean cube
